mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch: keyword search, a category listing, current specials, products by stockcode or barcode (EAN), any Woolworths URLs, the list of departments / categories / specials groups, or the full catalogue from our nightly snapshot (fast; set Max items high, filters apply), or the store directory (all ~1140 supermarkets: address, coordinates, opening hours). Instore: mobile price/location for explicit productIds and exactly one storeId; shared four-hour cache with live fallback through our VPS. Mobile rows have a store-data add-on when active; see README and the Apify Pricing tab for total rates and effective date.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Used in 'search' mode. Each query is searched separately.

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Used in 'category' mode, e.g. https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/browse/dairy-eggs-fridge/milk. Tip: run mode 'List categories' to get every category URL.

productIds.title: Stockcodes
productIds.description: Used in products and instore modes: the stockcode in a product URL, e.g. 88436. Instore requires explicit numeric IDs; it does not search the catalogue.

barcodes.title: Barcodes (EAN / GTIN)
barcodes.description: Used in 'barcodes' mode: the number under the barcode on the pack, e.g. 9310199012717. Barcodes Woolworths doesn't sell are listed in the run summary.

urls.title: Woolworths URLs
urls.description: Used in 'urls' mode: paste any product, search, category or specials page URL (or a bare stockcode). Each is fetched the right way automatically.

specialsGroups.title: Specials groups
specialsGroups.description: Used in 'specials' mode. Empty = every product on special or with a shelf-price label, promotions first. Values: half-price, buy-more-save-more, lower-shelf-price, seasonal-price, bundles, everyday-low-price.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum products per query / category / URL (after filters). For specials, products and the full catalogue: per run (the catalogue has ~25-30k products).

storeIds.title: Store numbers
storeIds.description: StoreNo from Store directory mode. Web modes emit one row per product/store with store price and inStock when reported. Mobile instore requires exactly one numeric storeId, e.g. 1416 (Double Bay), and returns native availability label/style and aisle/location data when reported; it does not emit generic inStock. Uses a four-hour store cache or live data from our VPS.

postcodes.title: Postcodes
postcodes.description: Australian postcodes (up to 500): every Woolworths supermarket in each postcode. A postcode without a Woolworths gives no rows; the run warnings name its nearest store and distance, so you can add it to Store numbers.

allStores.title: All Woolworths stores
allStores.description: Store rows for every Woolworths supermarket (~1140). Combine with a small Max items: every product becomes one row per store.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Result order. Relevance, price, unit price, name, specials and newest are applied by Woolworths before paging; biggest discount re-sorts the collected results by % off (use with specialsOnly and a high Max items). Price sorts skip products that are unavailable online (no price).

specialsOnly.title: Only products on special
specialsOnly.description: Keep only products currently on special / half price.

minPrice.title: Minimum price (AUD)
minPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or above this amount.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price (AUD)
maxPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or below this amount.

minRating.title: Minimum customer rating
minRating.description: Keep only products with an average customer rating of at least this many stars (0-5). Products without ratings are skipped.

includeMarketplace.title: Include Everyday Market (third-party sellers)
includeMarketplace.description: Also return products sold by third-party Everyday Market sellers (furniture, electronics, ...). Off = products sold by Woolworths only.

excludeCategories.title: Exclude departments
excludeCategories.description: Departments to leave out, by name or URL slug, e.g. 'beer-wine-spirits' or 'Pet'.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Keep only these brands (exact brand name, case-insensitive), e.g. 'Dairy Farmers', 'Woolworths'. Empty = all brands.

minDiscountPercent.title: Minimum discount (%)
minDiscountPercent.description: Keep only specials at least this many percent below the was-price, e.g. 40. Multi-buy offers (no was-price) are skipped.

dietary.title: Dietary requirements
dietary.description: Keep only products tagged with ALL of these, e.g. Gluten Free, Vegan, Vegetarian, Halal, Dairy Free, Low Sugar.

excludeAllergens.title: Exclude allergens
excludeAllergens.description: Skip products that contain or may contain any of these, e.g. Peanuts, Tree Nuts, Milk, Gluten. Products without allergen data are skipped too.

minHealthStarRating.title: Minimum Health Star Rating
minHealthStarRating.description: Keep only products rated at least this many health stars (0.5-5).

maxSugarPer100g.title: Max sugar per 100 g/mL (g)
maxSugarPer100g.description: Keep only products with at most this much sugar per 100 g/mL. Products without nutrition data are skipped.

minProteinPer100g.title: Min protein per 100 g/mL (g)
minProteinPer100g.description: Keep only products with at least this much protein per 100 g/mL.

changedSince.title: Only price changes since
changedSince.description: Return only products whose price changed since this date/time (e.g. 2026-09-01), or 'last-run' for changes since your previous run with the same input. Uses our nightly online price observations; not store-price history.

includeDisappeared.title: Include disappeared products
includeDisappeared.description: With 'Price changed since' = last-run: also list products your previous run returned that are gone now (delisted or no longer matching), as rows with type 'disappeared'.

priceHistoryDays.title: Include price history (days)
priceHistoryDays.description: Add available online price observations from the last N days (0 = off). previousPrice and priceChangedAt describe observed online changes, when known. History fields are omitted from store-priced rows; instore has no price history.

onlyNew.title: Only new products
onlyNew.description: Only products that appeared at Woolworths in the last 7 days.

onlyNewSpecials.title: Only new specials
onlyNewSpecials.description: Only products that went on special in the last 7 days (specials change every Wednesday).

fetchFullDetails.title: Fetch full product details
fetchFullDetails.description: Adds the printed nutrition panel (per serving and per 100 g/mL), country of origin and all product images. Needs one extra request per product, so it is slower, and it is charged as a separate event per product. Description, ingredients, allergens, health star rating and dietary tags are always included for free.

maxAgeHours.title: Max data age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: We refresh every product nightly (Sydney time). Data older than this, or read before this week's specials change (Wednesday), is fetched live instead. 0 = always fetch live. Mobile instore: positive values are capped at 4 hours; 0 forces live through our VPS.

includeRaw.title: Include raw payload
includeRaw.description: Add the original Woolworths payload to each record (every attribute, including ones we don't map).
